snippet.title: Ultimate Mythic Ski Jumping League [Official Trailer earlyAccess v0.8]
snippet.description:
"Ultimate Mythic Ski Jumping League" is a mixture of a ski jump game but with lots of RPG elements. 

This is the official trailer, full playable early release will be available July 2025 on Steam!

You can play alone or up to 75 players in one season. Currently only local multiplayer is possible.

Start your ski jump at the best possible time, hold it straight while driving down, hold it straight and try to ride the wind while you are flying and land straight and at the right time, at last try not to fall until you reached the end of the landing area.

Choose between 16 human or mythic races, most of them have two genders. 

All have between 30 and 50 cloth or equipment parts.

There are 10 different trainers to improve your skills, 10 different sponsor you can try to deal with, you can also take potions to help you for the next contest.

You can level up and improve abilities and skills permanently.

There are 8 different ski jumps each with a unique environment and 6 different season with changing day- and night times.

You can listen to our self-made (instrumental) soundtrack or chose of one of 18 complelty different music styles that were made by ai including singing voices, containing style like Irish Folk, 80s pop or even Goth and Nu Metal.
